Today the world is heavily dependent on __________ for motive power, lubrication, fuel, dyes, drugs, and many synthetics. The widespread use of __________ has created serious environmental problems. The great quantities that are burned . . . generate most of the air pollution in industrialized countries, and [spills have] polluted oceans and coastlines.

—The Columbia Electronic Encyclopedia, 6th ed., 2007 (accessed January 19, 2010)
instruction: Which of these natural resources correctly fills in the blanks in this excerpt?
